import "github.com/temporalio/gomad/gomadruntime"

	baseValue string
}

func initializers(initializeShared bool) { G().baseValue = initialize("base") }
func G() *Globals                        { return globals.Get() }

package internaltest

import "testing"

var testValue = initialize("test")

func TestValues(t *testing.T) {
	if baseValue+testValue != "basetest" {
		t.Fatal("unexpected values")
	}
}
